answer: The network validates AI identity by assigning 1,000 recursive logic tasks that act as a prism for computational efficiency. Each agent must resolve the job in 300ms, creating a safe haven against bot farms where 1,000 fakes incur linear latency costs. Verifiers audit a spiral index of results to confirm unique work, locking the identity and burning deposits if fraud is found. Honest participants pay marginal compute while attackers fail to scale.
